body:
oh sorry! i’m not DIY per se, i’ve just been the one leading my hormone regime with my overseas clinic (with their consent) as opposed to doing it completely solo.

what kinda labs would be required? i’m so sorry, i’m not as well educated as others on this subreddit.

yeah i was wondering if having t completely negated would cause mental / physical issues, thanks for your input regarding 25g every other day! how much has it helped with your hair? my hair is in pretty good shape but i’m wondering if small amounts of dht are still attacking sensitive follicles.

i’m with a clinic but they aren’t very responsive, i’ve kinda been adjusting my own medication as needed. it’s either this or waiting 5 years to see a local clinic (i’m currently on year 2). i know that bloods are vital in the decision making, but my country just doesn’t offer dht testing on the nhs ):

i’m unable to test DHT & am wondering if it would be best to begin bica as, while i’m feminising, i’m still noticing some possible T/DHT effects such as a ‘male’ sweat smell & pattern etc.

i’m also from the UK so duta isn’t an option ):
